I am locating every distinct server-side enforcement site for memo visibility.

Checking API handlers, file server, RSS, and other server surfaces for memo visibility checks.

I am identifying distinct server surfaces that enforce memo visibility.

I have mapped out roughly ten distinct enforcement sites across the API, file server, RSS, frontend, SSE, and attachment services.

I am now examining specific functions to confirm distinct enforcement boundaries. I will verify checkMemoReadAccess, fileserver attachment permissions, memo_share GetMemoByShare, ListMemos visibility filters, frontend SSR, RSS, SSE canReceive, memo relations, comments, and notification visibility.

The attachment_service checkAttachmentAccess helper is being examined as another enforcement site.

Additional enforcement sites include GetMemoByShare, the frontend explore page, RSS, ListMemoRelations, reaction_service, ListMemoAttachments, canViewMemoInNotification, and email notifications. The first two server surfaces identified are checkMemoReadAccess in api v1 memo_service.go and the ListMemos visibility filter in memo_service.go.

FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission in fileserver.go is another enforcement site. SSEClient.canReceive in sse_hub.go, ListMemoReactions in reaction_service.go, CreateMemoComment visibility checks in memo_service_comments.go, and batchConvertMemoRelations visibility filtering in memo_service_converter.go were also identified.

user_service_stats visibility filters are another enforcement site. The attachment_service access check, memo_share, and frontend list functions are being examined next.

GetMemoByShare bypasses normal visibility checks via share tokens. This is an access path rather than visibility enforcement.

Checking reaction_service, memo_aice, memo_relation, and attachment_service for additional distinct enforcement sites.

Checking CreateMemoComment visibility at line 41.

Found additional enforcement sites: ListMemoComments checkMemoReadAccess, batchConvertMemoRelations in memo_service_converter, email notification visibility, user_service_stats, and MCP service. ListMemoRelations does not check parent memo visibility directly; it relies on MemoFilter to enforce access on related memos.

APIV1Service.checkMemoReadAccess enforces visibility in memo_service.go:39. ListMemos filters visibility in memo_service.go:218-226. Attachment access is checked in attachment_service.go:422. FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission enforces permissions for /file/attachments in fileserver.go. Reaction services enforce inline checks in reaction_service.go:29-40 and :82+. ListMemoAttachments enforces inline checks in memo_attachment_service.go:213.

SSEClient.canReceive enforces visibility in sse_hub.go:134. RSS feed visibility is public in rss.go:90 and :141. Frontend sitemap visibility is public in frontend.go:150. Notification access checks in user_service_notifications.go:302 and email notifications in email.go:313 are also enforcement sites.

The distinct enforcement sites are being grouped by server surface. checkMemoReadAccess is a single site used by multiple handlers. ListMemos is a separate site because it has its own filter logic. Each site will be listed once with its file path.

`canViewerAccessMemo` is duplicated in `email.go` and `user_service_notifications.go`.

Other enforcement sites found:

- `checkMemoReadAccess` — `memo_service.go:39`
- `ListMemos` visibility filter — `memo_service.go:218-226`
- `checkAttachmentAccess` — `attachment_service.go:422`
- `checkAttachmentPermission` — `fileserver.go` (~640-703)

- `ListMemoReactions` visibility — `reaction_service.go:29-40`
- `UpsertMemoReaction` / `DeleteMemoReaction` visibility — `reaction_service.go:82+`
- `ListMemoAttachments` — `memo_attachment_service.go:213-224`
- `ListMemoRelations` — `memo_relation_service.go:107-112`
- `batchConvertMemoRelations` — `memo_service_converter.go:182-187`
- `CreateMemoComment` — `memo_service_comments.go:41`
- `SSEClient.canReceive` — `sse_hub.go:134`
- RSS `ListMemos` public-only — `rss.go:88-90` and user RSS near `~141`
- Frontend sitemap public-only — `frontend.go:149-150`

`ListAllUserStats` visibility filter — `user_service_stats.go:83-91`

`GetMemoByShare` intentionally bypasses visibility via share tokens; it is an alternative access path, not a visibility enforcement site.

No MCP visibility checks were found.

Compiling the full list of memo visibility enforcement sites with their file paths.

h15.

checkMemoReadAccess — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
ListMemos visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`  
ListMemoComments (via checkMemoReadAccess) — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`  
CreateMemoComment visibility gate — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go`  
ListMemoReactions visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`  
UpsertMemoReaction / DeleteMemoReaction visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go`  
ListMemoAttachments visibility check — `server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go`  
checkAttachmentAccess — `server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go`  
ListMemoRelations memoFilter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go`  
batchConvertMemoRelations memoFilter — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`  
ListAllUserStats visibility filter — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go`  
canViewerAccessMemo (notifications) — `server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go`  
SSEClient.canReceive — `server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`  
FileServerService.checkAttachmentPermission — `server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go`  
RSS feed VisibilityList (public only) — `server/router/rss/rss.go`  
Frontend sitemap VisibilityList (public only) — `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`  
canViewerAccessMemo (email links) — `server/notification/email.go`

Memo visibility is enforced in multiple places, not only through `checkMemoReadAccess`. That helper covers single-memo reads such as `GetMemo` and `ListMemoComments` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-67`, `:356`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`).

List endpoints apply query-time filters instead: `ListMemos` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-226`), `ListMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:107-112`), `batchConvertMemoRelations` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:182-187`), and `ListAllUserStats` (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:83-91`).

HTTP surfaces outside gRPC/API v1 also filter or gate access: attachment serving (`server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:674-701`), RSS (`server/router/rss/rss.go:88-90`), and the public sitemap (`server/router/frontend/frontend.go:149-150`).

Live updates and notifications apply their own rules: SSE delivery (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:134-143`), in-app notifications (`server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316`), and email links (`server/notification/email.go:306-319`).
